description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rawathawatta, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520201 (24/0060)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, extents, encumbrances, and legal status. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
